signal: Mesh Systems formed a strategic partnership with Exein in January 2026 to embed firmware-level cybersecurity in connected devices for US manufacturers, and led product talks at CES 2026.

email.subject1: a signal play for Mesh Systems
email.body1:
Dan, saw Mesh Systems partnered with Exein to embed firmware-level security in connected devices for US manufacturers.

A new partnership like that usually surfaces more manufacturers exploring connected products than the BD team can reach, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Mesh Systems off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dan, quick follow-up for Mesh Systems.

With the Exein partnership and the CES momentum, the pipeline target probably grew faster than the team can. Most BD leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Mesh Systems needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dan, last bit of proof for Mesh Systems.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Mesh Systems' reply rate likely compares to peer IoT and connected-product teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know launching a new partnership keeps a BD calendar packed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Mesh Systems' motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
